notes.title: NEW RELEASE DATE 2ND DECEMBER!!!
notes.notes:
Let's gooooo!! Ponpu will finally launch on the 2nd of December :D 

And that is not all! On the day of the launch, the super cool sponsored competition we have put together with the awesome guys at G-Loot will also commence! 

You'll automatically join the competition when playing the game, the official landing page with all the details will come online very soon and we will make sure to post it here as soon as it is ready :) 

Can't wait to share Ponpu with everyone, we really hope you'll enjoy the game! 


Love / Purple Tree
